profile.headline: Software Developer
profile.summary:
I have always been interested in technology as a student, so now I want to take it to the next and continue to learn more in my profession and future. I always enjoyed challenges and facing new opportunities to learn and grow as a person and developer. I like to meet deadlines and work continuously in my education. With perseverance and hard work, I would like to continue on my future and continue to grow.

I have one year experience in Software Development. My first year as a professional showed me that I still need to learn a lot more than I realized and that there are resources for me to become successful in learning technology.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Overhaul work on Site Administrator website.

Developed new look using HTML5 adding new buttons and information two new buttons one for export and control of the table. Imported new background and added new <div> tags for the control of the website. CSS was also imported into the site and changed colors of buttons to match the colors requested and make it flow more accurately with the rest of the website.

JQuery was used to add new <script> tags and help the creation of a new data table that would export the information requested into the excel sheet format. This script added the functionality of the buttons into working condition. The export was required to be in comma separated information which required a JavaScript change.

JavaScript was used to control the MVC of the DataTables API. The main function was implemented using OOP concepts where used to make the flow of the code adequate for the deployment of the website in the AWS server. After completing the work, I used GIT to push the changes and eventually the new changes were implemented.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Worked in back end applications using Java to work on a deployed web application.

Using Spring Boot to launch the website in the TOMCAT server. After the launching of the web app I used Hibernate to work with one other colleague and help version with version control. 

JSP was used to form the pages which users would see and add new HTML5 to the pages as requested for user input buttons or styling of the page.

Java JEE 8.0 was heavily used in conjunction with Eclipse to write the rest of the backend framework. I added features that where requested in order for user to add input and control the responses.

JDBC was used to control the information on the page and redirect it to the Oracle SQL server. Once the users pressed buttons the information was kept alive with the JDBC connection to the server and changed accordingly to the user’s input.

MAVEN was used to gather all the necessary libraries used in the project. I was responsible to making sure the correct versions were being requested when needed or the newest one depending on the project’s need. This was used to help maintain older applications that had stopped working and needed to be looked at for new code to be introduced.

SpringBoot was used to create most of the applications. I worked on the servlets and making sure the XML files were correct in order for the JSP to show in the Tomcat server.

I was tasked with testing SQL stored methods in order to verify that new implementation of application was working correctly. Using the Oracle framework, I wrote a script to verify that information was being stored correctly and build the test in Eclipse.
